India’s shift towards non-fossil energy comes with a big question: how do you store electricity when availability is not constant?​
IndiGrid is making a large-scale Battery Energy Storage System built to store electricity and release it when needed, bringing renewable energy storage to an extraordinary scale.​
But building a battery this big is a journey of its own. From transport hurdles to overheating safeguards, every step brings a new challenge.​
Watch Extreme Tech: The Energy Storage on National Geographic and streaming on JioHotstar. ​
